mideast.title: House Manager/Governess job
mideast.blurb: A European family in Dubai seeks an experienced Governess/House Manager to oversee childcare, household management, and family logistics. The role requires strong organizational skills, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

mideast.title: Executive Assistant
mideast.blurb: A degree-educated EA is sought to relocate to Saudi Arabia to work for an international company in smart offices, with a full relocation and settling-in package provided. Duties include complex diary management, international travel and visa coordination, and confidential correspondence and reports.
